title: The Enchanted Forest
description: A child-appropriate discovery and safety arc. The young traveler enters a gentle forest where friendly creatures teach them that feelings are not scary — they are messengers.

acts.title: The Friendly Path
acts.description: Soft light, warm colors. A small creature appears and asks: what are you carrying today? The forest listens.

acts.title: The Feeling Garden
acts.description: Each emotion grows as a flower. Anger is a red thornbush — beautiful but prickly. Sadness is a blue rain cloud that waters the garden.

acts.title: The Treehouse
acts.description: The traveler builds a treehouse in the canopy — a safe place that is always there. The creatures promise to guard it.
